headline: BRICS Summit leaders confirm viral 'candid' video was actually a shared attempt to figure out how to reset a hotel room thermostat
body: Global heads of state were captured on camera during the BRICS summit frantically debating the complex touch-screen interface of a climate control unit that kept alternating between Arctic levels and sauna heat. Sources confirm the high-level diplomatic huddle concluded only after a hotel technician arrived to explain that the device was not, in fact, a miniature teleconference console.
caption: When global powers unite, it's usually for world-changing policy—not to battle a hotel thermostat. Who knew the real challenge was the 'Auto' setting? #BRICS2026 #Diplomacy #ThermostatWars (satire)
igHook: Tag the one friend you know who would immediately try to hack the hotel AC during a global summit.
imagePrompt: A wide-angle, slightly blurry candid shot of several suited figures standing around a sleek, modern wall-mounted control panel in a dimly lit, upscale conference room corridor.
